top_strength: Grant methodically probed for a room-by-room inventory (bedroom count, TV sizes/quantities, appliances, fragile items, box estimate) and stayed patient when the customer got confused about the three-day pack/load/drive timeline, re-explaining it clearly until she understood.
coaching_note: Grant used the customer's name only once, at the very opening ('Hi, Santi'), and never again across the ~14-minute call — working her name back in periodically (especially when confirming the walkthrough handoff) would build more rapport heading into the estimate.
phone_presence_notes: Grant is polite and patient throughout, but leans on repetitive filler affirmations ('gotcha,' 'good deal,' 'alrighty') rather than personalized acknowledgment — he didn't engage with the customer's mention of relocating for a job opportunity beyond a flat 'gotcha.'
